pairs.question: Quid vidisti?
pairs.answer: Aquas utique, sed non solas: levitas illic ministrantes, summum sacerdotem interrogantem et consecrantem.
pairs.derivation: Genuine authorial-rhetorical interrogative posed and immediately answered. Answer ends at the first full stop; what follows ("Primo omnium docuit te Apostolus non ea contemplanda...") turns from answering to a long scriptural digression and is cut. No framing words to strip; no editorial brackets present. The section marker "8." was stripped.
